title: C¹ critical slices are Hᵏ-null for Lᵐ-a.e. y (Simon Ch. 2, consequence of (6.3))
statement: Let m, k ∈ ℕ with k > 0, n := m + k, and G : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1). Let C := {u ∈ ℝⁿ : DG(u) is not surjective}. Then Hᵏ(C ∩ G⁻¹{y}) = 0 for Lᵐ-a.e. y ∈ ℝᵐ. Notation (as in the parent): ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); Hˢ = μHE[s] (applied to an arbitrary set it is the Hausdorff outer measure); Lᵈ = volume; normDet = Mathlib's LinearMap.normDet; P* = LinearMap.adjoint P; DF(u) = fderiv ℝ F u.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m), 0 < k → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), μHE[k] ({u | ¬ Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G u)} ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}) = 0
